title: France unrest: Macron vows ban on 'illegitimate' protests in coming days
summary_full: In response to escalating unrest, French President Emmanuel Macron unveiled plans to prohibit unauthorized protests while ramping up security measures. Following extensive riots and vandalism, authorities brace for further gatherings this weekend. Trade unions and recognized groups will be directed to alternative protest paths to mitigate potential damage, with the initial disturbances rooted in student protests spurring broader demonstrations against rising living costs, just ahead of France's upcoming presidential election.
